label: source inspection
title: Read files
question: read source files or local logs without modifying them?

label: source search
title: Search files
question: search local files, symbols, or directory contents?

label: file edits
title: Edit files
question: write or edit a file directly, or execute a script intended to write or edit a file? Include purposeful file creation, replacement, modification, moving or deletion through Python, shell, Node or other scripts. Use visible script contents and invocation context; do not assume an opaque external script writes files just because a path is mentioned. Reading files, printing source code, quoted editing instructions, incidental test/build artifacts and log redirection alone do not qualify.

label: checks
title: Validation
question: run tests or validation? Include test runners, repository validation scripts, linters, formatters and type checks. A build-only command is building, not validation. Merely reading test logs, displaying CI results or mentioning tests in a string does not run tests or validation.

label: Git inspection
title: Git inspection
question: inspect Git history, refs, status, or diffs?

label: Git changes
title: Git changes
question: change Git commits, index, refs, or checkout?

label: Git synchronization
title: Git synchronization
question: fetch, push, pull, or clone a Git repository?

label: GitHub inspection
title: GitHub inspection
question: read GitHub pull requests, issues, CI results, or repository metadata?

label: GitHub changes
title: GitHub changes
question: create or change GitHub pull requests, issues, reviews, CI runs, or repository settings?

label: environment management
title: Environment management
question: configure or manage development processes, services, dependencies, or worktrees?

label: web requests
title: Web requests
question: retrieve data from a web service other than GitHub?

label: builds
title: Build
question: build or compile an application, package, or other software artifact?

label: task management
title: Task management
question: inspect, create, update, relate, or manage tasks, tickets, workflows, or execution records? Judge operations on those records, not source code or quoted text merely mentioning tasks or workflows.

label: coordination
title: Coordination
question: delegate work, exchange agent messages, wait for agents, or request a human decision? Merely polling a terminal process or sleeping is not agent or human coordination.

label: visual inspection
title: Visual inspection
question: inspect an application's UI structure, screenshots, images, or rendered output? Reading UI source code or merely creating an image does not qualify. This concerns observation, not clicking or typing.

label: UI interaction
title: UI interaction
question: operate a desktop application or browser through clicks, typing, keyboard input, navigation, or focus changes? Merely observing screenshots or UI structure does not qualify.

label: runtime inspection
title: Runtime inspection
question: inspect or diagnose a running application through runtime evaluation, logs, traces, database queries, or internal application state? Include application introspection through MCP tools such as Tidewave. Judge the visible code or query intent: runtime evaluation and SQL can mutate state, so a tool name alone does not establish inspection. Mutating application state, reading source code, or running tests alone does not qualify.
